title: Exciting updates for Sneaky Sasquatch come to Apple Arcade
title_zh: 苹果Arcade迎来Sneaky Sasquatch激动更新

paragraphs.en: Sneaky Sasquatch fans can jump into an exciting crossover with Subway Surfers+ today and check out the new birdwatching update arriving September 17. More Sasquatch, more fun: Today, the sneakiest crossover of the summer lands exclusively on Apple Arcade. Through October 7, Sneaky Sasquatch transforms the iconic world of Subway Surfers+ with the charm and aesthetic of the hit open-world Arcade game. Players can unlock four character skins and two unique hoverboards, and dash through a reimagined level inspired by Sasquatch Valley locations, with raccoon coins replacing the classic gold ones and the security guard trading his usual look for a ranger disguise. But the sneakiness doesn’t stop there — fans have plenty more to look forward to with a major update arriving September 17. “Sneaky Sasquatch is the most beloved game on Apple Arcade and has had one of the most passionate communities of players since day 1,” said Alex Rofman, Apple’s senior director of Apple Arcade. “This exclusive crossover with Subway Surfers+ and the new birdwatching update are just the latest ways players can enjoy Sneaky Sasquatch, with more awesome updates planned for the game over the coming months.” Sneaky Sasquatch takes over Subway Surfers+ complete with raccoon coins and a ranger-disguised security guard. Add birdwatching to the extensive list of fun and mischievous adventures players can experience in Sneaky Sasquatch, from skiing down snowy slopes to racing customized sports cars to becoming a doctor — and everything in between. On September 17, more than 30 species of birds will appear in Sneaky Sasquatch’s world, ready to be spotted, snapped, and logged. Players can snap a photo and deliver it to the birder to log in the bird database to earn rewards. Not every shot is created equal, though: Photos are graded on the quality of composition and subject, with bonuses for a bird’s rarity, a brand-new sighting, or a lucky multi-bird shot. Birdwatching comes to Sneaky Sasquatch on September 17. That’s not all — available now in celebration of Sneaky Sasquatch’s birthday are all-new Messages stickers featuring 11 festive designs full of Sasquatch-size fun. They have been added to the previously released Sneaky Sasquatch sticker pack featuring silly expressions and campground shenanigans. Download all-new stickers in Messages in celebration of Sneaky Sasquatch’s birthday. Pricing and Availability Apple Arcade is available for $6.99 (U.S.) per month with a one-month free trial.
paragraphs.zh: 《Sneaky Sasquatch》的粉丝们今天就可以体验与《Subway Surfers+》的精彩联动，并探索将于 9 月 17 日推出的全新观鸟更新。 更多巨猿，更多乐趣：今天，夏季最神秘的联动内容将独家登陆 Apple Arcade。 截至 10 月 7 日，《Sneaky Sasquatch》将以这款热门开放世界街机游戏的魅力与美学风格，重塑《Subway Surfers+》的经典世界。 玩家可以解锁四款角色皮肤和两款独特的悬浮滑板，在受巨猿谷地地点启发的重新设计的关卡中疾驰；浣熊硬币将取代经典的金币，而保安则会换上护林员的伪装。 但神秘感远不止于此——粉丝们还有更多内容值得期待，因为一次重大更新将于 9 月 17 日上线。Apple Arcade 高级总监 Alex Rofman 表示：“《Sneaky Sasquatch》是 Apple Arcade 上最受欢迎的游戏，自发布第一天起就拥有最热情的玩家社区之一。这次与《Subway Surfers+》的独家联动以及全新的观鸟更新，只是玩家享受《Sneaky Sasquatch》的最新方式；未来几个月还将为这款游戏规划更多精彩的更新。”《Sneaky Sasquatch》将全面接管《Subway Surfers+》，并加入浣熊硬币和伪装成护林员的保安。 在《Sneaky Sasquatch》中，玩家可以从滑雪、驾驶定制跑车到成为医生等丰富有趣的冒险活动中，增添观鸟这一新体验。 9 月 17 日，超过 30 种鸟类将出现在《Sneaky Sasquatch》的世界中，等待玩家发现、拍摄和记录。 玩家可以拍摄照片并交给观鸟专家，将其录入鸟类数据库以赢取奖励。 不过，并非所有照片都同等有效：照片将根据构图和主体的质量进行评分，稀有鸟类、首次发现或幸运地同时拍到多只鸟的照片还将获得额外奖励。 观鸟功能将于 9 月 17 日登陆《Sneaky Sasquatch》。 不仅如此——为庆祝《Sneaky Sasquatch》的生日，全新 Messages 贴纸现已上线，包含 11 款充满巨猿级乐趣的节日主题设计。 这些贴纸已加入此前发布的《Sneaky Sasquatch》贴纸包中，该贴纸包还包含各种搞怪表情和露营地趣事。 立即下载 Messages 中的全新贴纸，庆祝《Sneaky Sasquatch》的生日吧。 价格与可用性：Apple Arcade 每月收费 6.99 美元（美国），并提供一个月免费试用期。
